description: This file contains the PHP source code for the CustomerTransaction model class within the OpenCart admin extension. It defines methods to retrieve and count customer transaction data from the database, including filtering by date range and customer details.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Model class for fetching customer transaction data, including transaction details and total counts, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions with optional filtering by date range and customer name, supports pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique customers with transactions, with optional filtering by date range and customer name.
